description: An ILLUSTRATIVE instance of kye.clip_script.v1, showing the anatomy of a ~30-second explainer: a nerve, a specific moment, a sentence from someone other than KYE, what KYE does about it, and the mark. The operational registry is private; this example exists so the SHAPE is public and machine-readable (§43) without publishing the working scripts.

duration_contract.rationale: 30 seconds at an unhurried 150 wpm is ~75 words; the ceiling leaves headroom without letting a script become a 45-second clip that gets cut where nobody chose.

clips.title: An example clip, showing the section anatomy only.

script.text: A named thing that has already gone wrong, in the viewer's own words.
The next fifteen seconds of that scenario, where the viewer recognises what their own team actually does.
Someone other than KYE says it: an exact sentence, quoted verbatim.
What the viewer gets — outcome only. Mechanism never appears on a public surface.

clips.notes: Illustrative only. The `cites` id is deliberately not a real source: this file demonstrates the schema shape and is NOT checked by clip-registry-canonical, which reads the private operational registry and requires every citation to resolve to a fetched, hashed sentence.
